name: J-Town: A Visual Novel
source:
A corporate contractor has tasked you with infiltrating the quiet neighborhood of J-Town and finding a weakness for him to move in and open up a new store. However, as you meet the locals, they challenge you to see this community for what it really is. Residents from all walks of life come together to share what makes this place so special. Visit shops and establishments and dip your toe into the rich experiences that bring our real world Japantowns to life!

[edited from [url=https://iszacstartown.itch.io/j-town-a-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名企业承包商委托你潜入宁静的J-Town街区，找出可乘之机，好让他进驻这里开设新店。然而，当你逐渐认识当地居民，他们却促使你重新看待这个社区的真实面貌。来自各行各业的人们齐聚一堂，分享这里为何如此特别。走进店铺与各类场所，初步体验那些让现实中的日本城充满活力的丰富文化吧！

[根据[url=https://iszacstartown.itch.io/j-town-a-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]内容编辑]
